facts.subject: recruitment_brand
facts.value: AL-RIFA'I INTEGRATED SERVICES
conditions: Do not infer an unverified legal-entity relationship from an earlier or related name.

facts.subject: related_name_context
facts.value: Al-Aqsa remains in use as an earlier known name; this record does not establish a legal-entity relationship.
conditions: Do not present the relationship as legally verified.

facts.subject: employee_lifecycle
facts.value: interest -> applicant identification -> role interest -> eligibility -> intake -> documents -> interview/review -> selection -> training/practical learning -> probation/readiness -> joining -> assignment/deployment -> active employment

facts.subject: selection_and_joining
facts.value: office_review_and_decision_required; applicant claims do not establish selection, verification, or joining

facts.subject: office_address
facts.value: ভিক্টোরিয়া গেইট # ০১, আগ্রাপাড়া (আগ্রাপারা), Victoria Gate #1, উত্তর কাট্টলি-৪২১৭, একে খান মোড়, থানা: পাহাড়তলি, চট্টগ্রাম।

facts.subject: processing_or_joining_fee
facts.value: processing, joining, or application fees may exist; no illegal bribe; exact settled amounts are recorded in fee.amounts

facts.subject: advance_fee_payment_requirement
facts.value: advance payment is not an absolute prerequisite for joining
conditions: Other applicable joining conditions, required documents, readiness, and authorized recruitment decisions still apply.

facts.subject: early_departure_fee_adjustment
facts.value: Before six months, outstanding joining, training, and application fees are intended to be adjusted against salary or wages.
conditions: Do not execute automatic wage deductions.
Legality, written employment terms, worker authorization, and permitted deduction conditions require separate verification and approval.

facts.subject: readiness_and_document_examples
facts.value: Examples may include NID or birth registration, parents' voter/NID records, educational certificates, chairman/commissioner certificate, clothing, quilt or blanket, and mosquito net.
conditions: These are examples, not unconditional mandatory eligibility rules.
The applicable current role and authorized recruitment decision determine what is required.
Document receipt is not formal verification or a hiring decision.

facts.subject: available_roles
facts.value: Nine Recruitment role types: Escort; Survey Scout/Survey Escort; Security Guard; Security Supervisor; Assistant Supervisor; Operation Officer; Security In-Charge; Marketing Officer; Ghat Supervisor.
conditions: This is a role taxonomy, not nine confirmed vacancies.
Current vacancy status is recorded separately.

facts.subject: eligibility
facts.value: General age 18-55; physical fitness; new and experienced applicants eligible; Escort/Survey educational guidance is eighth grade/Dakhil/Alim with no previous experience required; Operation Officer requires a bachelor's degree.
conditions: Office review and role fit are still required; these rules do not guarantee hiring.

facts.subject: required_documents
facts.value: NID or birth registration; original chairman certificate; educational certificate; two stamp-size photographs; four passport-size photographs; CV; guardian's NID.
conditions: Submit all documents on the first office visit for joining.
The office may allow additional time if a document is missing.
No deadline or extension approval is recorded; the AI must not invent or claim one.

facts.subject: salary
facts.value: Operation Officer trial BDT 12,000-18,000 and permanent BDT 18,000-35,000+; Security Guard probation BDT 10,000-13,000 and permanent BDT 24,700; Escort/Survey training BDT 10,000-15,000.
conditions: Escort/Survey post-training range remains separately conflicting at BDT 12,000-24,000 versus BDT 12,000-17,000.
Do not use the unresolved post-training range as an exact value.

facts.subject: form_and_joining_fee_amount
facts.value: Form fee BDT 330; joining/training fee BDT 3,500; upfront payment is not an absolute condition for employment; proposed salary deduction is BDT 500 monthly against BDT 3,500; a refund arrangement exists.
conditions: The exact deduction/refund calendar is not approved.
Do not state an upfront amount, deadline, refund schedule, or automatic deduction beyond the approved proposal.

facts.subject: office_hours
facts.value: 09:00-17:00; Friday closed

facts.subject: training_and_practical_learning
facts.value: School training is 15 days and unpaid. Practical training/duty may begin from day one at a vessel, security post, or Narayanganj ghat; salary runs when sent to that practical workplace.
conditions: Do not substitute older 2-week, 45-day, or other durations.

facts.subject: probation
facts.value: Initial probation is 3 months, extendable by 3 months, up to 6 months total.

facts.subject: duty_hours_schedule_and_conditions
facts.value: Field/Escort approximately 6-8 hours assignment-dependent; Guard day shift 08:00-20:00; Guard night shift 20:00-08:00; overtime may be needed.
conditions: Overtime rate is not approved.
Leave, food, accommodation, and other employment conditions remain separately unresolved.

facts.subject: identity_and_intake
facts.value: Reuse an authorized WhatsApp/database username, mobile number, and email when actually available. A WhatsApp display name is not automatically a verified legal name. Name and relevant information may be extracted from an applicant-supplied NID or CV subject to access controls and confirmation of unclear fields.
conditions: Do not disclose beyond existing access controls.
Do not treat a display name as verified legal identity.

facts.subject: missing_intake_fields
facts.value: Ask for missing age, education, address, experience, and interested role; do not ask again for a reliable existing mobile number.

facts.subject: fee_deduction_refund_schedule
conditions: The owner approved a BDT 500 monthly proposal and refund arrangement, not the precise calendar.
